source_reviews.independent_solution: Frozen in source-solutions-frozen.md before opening the draft: voltage is energy per charge, so at constant U the electrical work is A = Uq. A is in joules, U in volts and q in coulombs; 1 J = 1 V * 1 C. At fixed q, doubling U doubles A; at fixed U, doubling q doubles A. Changing positive q at fixed positive U changes work by U times the charge change. Proportionality statements hold the other factor fixed, not resistance. No image or numerical data is required.

source_reviews.independent_solution: Frozen in source-solutions-frozen.md before opening the draft: for constant current during t seconds, q = It; substitution into the constant-voltage relation A = Uq gives A = UIt. Use U in volts, I in amperes, t in seconds, q in coulombs and A in joules: 1 C = 1 ampere * 1 s and 1 J = 1 V * 1 ampere * 1 s. UI alone is power in watts, not work. At fixed U and I, work is proportional to t. The product assumes U and I constant during the interval, not arbitrary time-varying readings.
